children: , the enterprise-networking and cybersecurity giant, secured a multiyear deal to overhaul connectivity across Notre Dame's athletics facilities and wider campus. Shares fell about 0.6% to $105.81 on 10.31am ET time on Thursday morning.

Nearly 1,000 Catalyst 9300X switches will anchor the rollout, supported by Catalyst Center, ThousandEyes and Cisco Professional Services. This is classic Cisco: bundle the hardware, monitoring software and technical expertise into one network that becomes difficult to replace once it is deeply embedded.

Notre Dame gives Cisco a prestigious showcase for its full technology stack, potentially opening doors at other universities and large institutions. The valuation leaves little room for a routine win, however: the stock trades 41.61% above its $74.72 GF Value estimate. With no contract value, margin contribution or recurring-revenue impact disclosed, the deal strengthens Cisco's credibility before it materially changes the numbers.

title: Cisco Drops as 1,000 Switches Build an AI Campus
